title: Fix PinJoint2D limits and motor

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Derive and implement new PinJoint2D constraint formulation
- Include split-impulse positional correction, as used in contact solver
- Include predictive parameter setup
- `GodotJoint2D::max_force` used for angular limit and motor max torque
- Motor chases target velocity using up to `max_force` torque
- Limits resist with up to `max_force` torque but will override motor
- Softness ignored for angular limits
- Inverted limits (high < low) create complementary permitted arc
- Minimum limit separation angle to avoid skipping narrow arcs
- Angular axis will lock if permitted arc falls under min separation
- Angular axis will free if restricted arc falls under min separation
- Position will correct towards closest limit when in restricted arc

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Closes #91691, #88481, #87513, #79863  
Replaces #104539, #120424

Addresses [Add angular and motor limits to PinJoint2D #4224](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/4224)  
Addresses [Add "Glue Joint" or "Fixed Joint" #86](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/86)

### Community context
[Angular limit on pin joints doesn’t work](https://forum.godotengine.org/t/angular-limit-on-pin-joints-doesnt-work/40646)  
[PinJoint2D - angular limits don’t work?](https://forum.godotengine.org/t/pinjoint2d-angular-limits-dont-work/41917)

I have tested samples from issues #88481, #79863, Pull request #104539, godot-demo-projects/2d/physics_tests, my own game, my custom test (included below) and a soft body test (not included).
